# UK Accessories — Full details

> UK Accessories is an online mobile accessories and tech gadgets store serving customers in Pakistan. Slogan: "Upgrade Your Tech. Elevate Your Style." Website: https://uk-accessories.vercel.app/

## About

UK Accessories is an online mobile accessories and tech gadgets store serving customers in Pakistan. It sells wireless earbuds, headphones, fast chargers, charging cables, power banks, smartwatches, phone cases and screen protectors, with prices in PKR. Orders in Pakistan can be paid by Cash on Delivery, or by manual JazzCash/Easypaisa payment verified by the shop over WhatsApp (+92 3170851250). International delivery is not advertised as available yet.

Primary market: Pakistan. Secondary: international customers (international delivery is not advertised as available until courier arrangements and rates are confirmed).

Support: WhatsApp +92 3170851250. Currency: PKR.

Prices shown are sample prices — confirm the price on WhatsApp before ordering if unsure (see FAQ). Product images are representative images, not exact photos of every model.

Physical shop context (separate from the online store): the owner's physical mobile shop is Umar Khayam Mobile Zone, KPK, Swabi, Shwa Adda, Abdus Sattar Plaza, Shop No. 16. UK Accessories is the online accessories store. No opening hours, geo coordinates, business email or social media links are published for UK Accessories, because none have been confirmed.

## Payments and delivery

- Cash on Delivery: available in Pakistan.
- JazzCash / Easypaisa: manual payment only. Place the order, share your transaction ID, and the shop verifies it. No automatic payment integration is claimed, and no payment account details are published on this site.
- Shipping: available in Pakistan. Demo shipping is Rs. 250, free over Rs. 5,000 (a demo rule, admin-configurable in the live store). Delivery estimates, zones and rates must be confirmed by the owner before they are promised.
- International shipping: not advertised as available yet.
- Returns: if an item arrives damaged or incorrect, contact UK Accessories on WhatsApp (+92 3170851250) with your order ID and photos. Eligible cancellations/refunds restore stock in the admin system. Manual-payment refunds are handled by the shop after verification. Final return windows and conditions are set by the owner in the live store settings.

## Privacy and terms (summaries; full pages on site)

- Privacy: the store collects only the information needed to process orders (name, phone, email, address and order details). In live mode it is stored in Supabase with Row Level Security — customers can only access their own data. Personal data is not sold. Privacy requests: WhatsApp +92 3170851250.
- Terms: products shown are sample products until approved. Prices are in PKR. Orders are subject to confirmation and stock availability. Manual payments are subject to verification. Nothing here promises international delivery until confirmed.
